Non-myelo- ablative conditioning protocols are under investigation.6-8 Allogeneic HSCT is suggested for younger patients with non-response or early relapse after purine analogues, or those who relapse within 2 years of an initial response with purine-analogue based therapy or autologous HSCT, or in patients with certain cytogenetic abnormalities with a poor prognosis.7 Other drugs that have been investigated for CLL include bortezomib,7 denileukin diftitox,7 lenalidomide,6,7,21 lumi- liximab,6,7 oblimersen sodium,7 ofatumumab,6 and thalid- omide.21 1.
